statement: You are given a boolean expression as a string expression. It alternates operands and operators: each operand is T (true) or F (false), and each operator is & (AND), | (OR) or ^ (XOR).
Add parentheses so that the expression is evaluated one operator at a time, in some order. Count the different ways to fully parenthesise it so that the result is true.

examples.explanation: Of the 5 ways to parenthesise it, only T|((F&T)^T) and T|(F&(T^T)) are true. Both keep the leading T| as the last operation.
(T^F)|F = T|F = true, and T^(F|F) = T^F = true, so both ways work.
(F|T)&F = T&F = false, and F|(T&F) = F|F = false, so no way works.
